product.title: Off Road Las Vegas Tour
product.description: Trade the casino corridor for desert terrain on this Off Road Las Vegas Tour. The route focuses on rugged trails and open Nevada backcountry, giving travelers a direct off-road experience with guide support and a strong desert-adventure profile.
highlights: Guided off-road adventure through Las Vegas-area desert trails
Rugged route built around dirt tracks and open terrain
Guide-led safety and route briefing before departure
Photo opportunities at scenic desert overlooks
additionalInfo: This tour operates in desert conditions; hydrate before departure.
Driver-license requirements vary by selected option.

meetingPoint.description: Meeting point details are provided after booking; select Las Vegas pickup locations may be available depending on option.

itineraryItems.title: Desert base check-in
itineraryItems.description: Arrive for orientation, route briefing, and equipment prep.

itineraryItems.title: Off-road trail session
itineraryItems.description: Follow your guide onto rugged terrain featuring climbs, washes, and open desert sections.

itineraryItems.title: Scenic stop
itineraryItems.description: Pause for photos and trail-side interpretation.

faqs.question: Is this a beginner-friendly off-road experience?
faqs.answer: The operator provides a safety briefing and guided pacing suitable for many first-time off-road participants.
